title: NASA MODIS Monthly Vegetation NDVI: January 2020 and 2023
description: NASA MODIS Terra monthly vegetation greenness (NDVI) comparison for January 2020 and January 2023.

source.disclaimer: Satellite-derived vegetation greenness index. NDVI is not a direct measurement of forest cover, forest height, or deforestation. Quality filtering and coarse spatial averaging may exclude observations.

channels.name: Vegetation Greenness (NDVI)
channels.description: Quality-filtered MODIS NDVI, originally ranging from -0.2 to 1.0, normalized to [0,1] using a shared fixed scale. Higher values generally indicate greener vegetation.

legend.pitch: Higher pitch indicates higher vegetation NDVI, not directly greater forest cover.
legend.stereo: Horizontal geographic grid position controls stereo panning.
legend.silence: Cells with insufficient valid observations are silent; missing does not mean zero vegetation.

processing.method: QA-filtered mean of MODIS monthly NDVI per grid cell
processing.quality_filter: MODLAND_QA=0, pixel_reliability=0, land_water_flag=1, valid NDVI range
processing.limitations: Global coarse-grid NDVI is not forest-only. Unequal valid-pixel coverage between years may affect comparisons. Cells represent unweighted averages of valid source pixels, not equal-area averages.
